description: Get the current status of a clip (kind "clip", default; same as `clipugc videos status <id>`) or of a merged ad (kind "ad"; same as `clipugc ads show <adId>`). This is the poll tool for create_clip, create_motion_clip and merge_ad. Status is pending, processing, completed or failed. A clip record also carries merge_status and merged_video_id once merged. Costs no credits.

id.description: Clip or ad id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

kind.description: "clip" (default) for a character video id, "ad" for a merged_video_id.

name: get_video
title: Get clip or ad status
